commands.name: assembleDebug
side_effects: may download Gradle, Android SDK, and dependencies into .gradle

commands.name: lintDebug
commands.purpose: Run Android lint for the debug variant.

commands.name: packageSignedRelease
side_effects: reads release keystore outside the repo

commands.name: python_api_tests
commands.command: cd python_api_bundle && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
commands.purpose: Run Python API client contract tests.

commands.name: deploy_android
commands.purpose: Build, install, grant runtime permissions, and launch the debug APK on a connected Android phone.

commands.name: pairing_qr
commands.purpose: Generate an ultra-compact ML1 QR pairing message and PNG.

commands.name: discover
commands.purpose: Discover miniloc phones with mDNS and optional IPv4 subnet fallback.

commands.name: poll
commands.purpose: Poll location data from a paired phone or an Open LAN phone.
side_effects: writes cache file under ~/.cache/miniloc by default

devices: optional connected Android phone for deploy and manual tests
network: same-LAN connectivity for discovery and polling

outputs.stdout: Human-readable text and JSON depending on command.
machine_readable_modes: ML1 pairing message printed by tools/miniloc_pairing_qr.py

exit_codes.1: validation, build, discovery, or runtime failure
exit_codes.2: argument parsing or command usage failure where provided by argparse/shell
exit_codes.130: keyboard interrupt for long-running polling commands
